message:
We all have that one friend who seems to panic at the first sign of trouble, right? You know, the one who calls in a frenzy about every little storm warning or emergency alert. The other day, they reached out to us, worried about an impending weather event, and it got us thinking. 

Instead of spiraling into worry, we shared our go-bag essentials and our family emergency plan. It was a gentle reminder that being prepared doesn’t have to mean living in fear; it can be empowering! 

How do you help your loved ones stay calm and prepared during tough times? We’d love to hear your tips!
